stories.title: Zara Larsson cancels her Abu Dhabi show over Sudan
stories.summary: Zara Larsson cancelled her Abu Dhabi concert in solidarity with Sudan, replying "I will not be going to Abu Dhabi" to a fan who asked her to. Pop Base's post got 243K likes, and a quote post defending her, "ditching a million dollar performance is not performative", got 143K.
